description: Fetch the full Markdown of one Griddo backoffice (Author Experience) documentation page by its path, as returned by search_griddo_editor_docs or list_griddo_editor_docs. Use it when the search excerpt is not enough to answer accurately.

path.description: Page path, e.g. '/editor/anadir-imagen'. The '.md' suffix, a leading slash and a full https://docs.griddo.io URL are all accepted.

name: get_griddo_editor_doc
title: Get a Griddo editor docs page
